questions.stem_text:
Nagel claims that prior to reflection, it is plausible that people cannot be morally
assessed for:

options.C: actions that do not violate anyone's rights.
options.E: what is due to factors beyond their control.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: E - what is due to factors beyond their control.

questions.stem_text:
Hume claims that a person who is unaffected by images of human happiness or misery will
also be indifferent to:
questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: C - virtue and vice.

questions.stem_text: Which mystic believed that evil was a distortion that reveals divine love more clearly?

Baxter claims that his "very general way" of stating what we should strive for
environmentally assumes that

options.A: we have unlimited resources to address environmental issues.
options.B: human satisfaction is the only measure of environmental success.
options.C: we can measure in some way the incremental units of human satisfaction.
options.D: we can precisely predict the environmental impact of our actions.
options.E: the environment is solely a human construct.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: C - we can measure in some way the incremental units of human satisfaction.
